mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates growing demand in the economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where the proxy shows a sustained increase, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a 3-month period signals strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases over 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over a 3-month period indicates a strengthening labor market, which increases consumer spending and boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the proxy shows a sustained increase, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% within a month signals deflationary pressure, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a quarter signals strong economic growth and a healthy labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and UNRATE decreases over 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
